newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Alumindo to float 92.4 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Alumindo to float 92.4 mln shares.

text.p: Indonesian aluminium steel and foil producer PT Alumindo Light Metal Industry said on Thursday it will float 92.4 million shares on the Jakarta and Surabaya stock exchanges to raise 120.12 billion rupiah.

In an advertisement in the Bisnis Indonesia newspaper, Alumindo said 62 percent of the proceeds would be used to increase its current production capacity of 42,000 tonnes of aluminium sheets and 7,200 tonnes of aluminium foil per year.
The company did not say by how much it would expand output.
Alumindo said 38 percent of the proceeds would be used to increase working capital to 109,152 billion rupiah from 33 billion rupiah.
The company set the offer price at 1,300 rupiah each share with a nominal value of 500 rupiah. The offer period will be between December 16 and 18.
The allotment date is December 23 and the listing will be on January 2. W.I Carr has been appointed lead underwriter.
